claims.statement: The target's code is copyright 2023-2026 by Sayantan Santra (sayantan.santra689@gmail.com).

claims.quote: <!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT -->
claims.statement: The target is licensed under the MIT licence, as declared in the file's SPDX header.

claims.quote: [![maintainer-badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/maintainer-SinTan1729-blue?logo=github)](https://github.com/SinTan1729)
claims.statement: The target is maintained by SinTan1729 (the badge states a fact about the target, not a host-computed count).

claims.quote: [![latest-release-badge](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/SinTan1729/chhoto-url?logo=github)](https://github.com/SinTan1729/chhoto-url/releases/latest)
claims.statement: The target has a latest release published on GitHub (the version badge states the release version).

claims.quote: A simple selfhosted URL shortener
claims.statement: The target is a URL shortener that can be self-hosted; the core function of the category exists.

claims.quote: with no unnecessary features
claims.statement: The target has no features beyond the essential ones — a boundary claim on the feature set.

claims.quote: The scratch docker image is <4.5 MB (compressed)
claims.statement: The scratch-variant Docker image of the target is smaller than 4.5 MB compressed.

claims.quote: the alpine one is <8.5 MB (compressed)
claims.statement: The alpine-variant Docker image of the target is smaller than 8.5 MB compressed.

claims.quote: it uses <10 MB of RAM under regular use
claims.statement: The target uses less than 10 MB of RAM under regular use.

claims.quote: I consider this project to be complete, not dead.
claims.statement: The seller characterises the project as complete and maintained rather than abandoned.

claims.quote: I'm unlikely to add any new features
claims.statement: The seller intends not to add new features to the target.

claims.quote: I will try and fix every bug you report
claims.statement: The seller commits to attempting to fix bugs reported to them.

claims.quote: I will also try to keep it updated in terms of security vulnerabilities.
claims.statement: The seller commits to applying security updates to the target.

claims.quote: I decided to rewrite it in Rust
claims.statement: The target is implemented in Rust, as a rewrite of the simply-shorten project.

claims.quote: add some features to it that I thought were essential (e.g. hit counting)
claims.statement: The target includes hit counting among its features.

claims.quote: The database is cleared every 15 minutes
claims.statement: The demo instance's database is wiped every 15 minutes.

claims.quote: Shortens URLs of any length
claims.statement: The tool accepts URLs of any length and shortens them (no length boundary).

claims.quote: to a randomly generated link
claims.statement: The shortened link is generated randomly rather than chosen by the caller by default.

claims.quote: Automatic expiry of links after a chosen time.
claims.statement: Links expire automatically after a time the user can choose.

claims.quote:
(Optional) Allows you to specify the shortened URL instead of the generated
  one.
claims.statement: Optionally, the user may specify their own shortened URL instead of the randomly generated one.

claims.quote:
Opening the shortened URL in your browser will instantly redirect you
  to the correct long URL.
claims.statement: Visiting a shortened URL redirects immediately to the correct long URL, with no interstitial page.

claims.quote: The docker image is only ~6MB
claims.statement: The Docker image is approximately 6 MB in size.

claims.quote:
RAM uasge
  stays under 5MB under normal use.
claims.statement: RAM usage stays under 5 MB under normal use (quote preserves the seller's spelling of "uasge").

claims.quote: Counts number of hits for each short link
claims.statement: The target records a hit count for each short link.

claims.quote: only the hit is recorded, and nothing else
claims.statement: Boundary claim: when a hit is counted, nothing besides the hit itself (no visitor data of any kind) is recorded.

claims.quote: Short links can be edited after creation.
claims.statement: An existing short link can be edited after it has been created.

claims.quote: Each short link may have custom notes attached to it.
claims.statement: Custom notes can be attached to each short link.

claims.quote:
The UI features filtering for links,
  based on short link, long link, and notes.
claims.statement: The UI provides filtering of links by short link, by long link, and by notes.

claims.quote: QR codes can be generated for easy sharing.
claims.statement: The target can generate QR codes for short links.

claims.quote: Supports operation using API key
claims.statement: The target can be operated using an API key.

claims.quote: lets the user provide hashed password and API key
claims.statement: The user can supply the password and API key in hashed form.

claims.quote: Has a robust JSON-RPC adjacent API.
claims.statement: The target exposes an API (described as JSON-RPC adjacent); the existence of a programmatic API is the testable property.

claims.quote: Has a mobile friendly UI
claims.statement: The UI is mobile friendly.

claims.quote: automatic dark mode.
claims.statement: The UI switches to dark mode automatically.

claims.quote: Can serve a custom landing page, if needed.
claims.statement: The target can serve a custom landing page when configured to do so.

claims.quote: Has a public mode, where anyone can add links without authentication.
claims.statement: A public mode exists in which anyone can add links without authenticating.

claims.quote:
Deleting
  or listing available links will need admin access using the password.
claims.statement: Deleting and listing links require admin access using the password.

claims.quote: It's also possible to completely disable the frontend.
claims.statement: The frontend can be completely disabled by configuration.

claims.quote:
It's also possible to force an expiry
  time for public instances
claims.statement: An expiry time can be forced for links on public instances.

claims.quote: Allows setting the URL of your website
claims.statement: The URL of the user's website (the base URL used for generated short links) is configurable.

claims.quote: Links are stored in an SQLite database
claims.statement: Links are stored in an SQLite database.

claims.quote: which is configured to be ACID by default
claims.statement: The SQLite database is configured to be ACID by default.

claims.quote: Options are available for tuning the database to the user's liking.
claims.statement: Configuration options exist for tuning the database.

claims.quote: Available as a Docker container
claims.statement: The target is distributed as a Docker container.

claims.quote: with a provided compose file.
claims.statement: A compose file is provided with the distribution.

claims.quote: Backend written in Rust using [Actix Web](https://actix.rs/)
claims.statement: The backend is written in Rust using the Actix Web framework.

claims.quote:
frontend
  written in plain HTML and vanilla JS, using [Pure CSS](https://purecss.io/)
  for styling.
claims.statement: The frontend is written in plain HTML and vanilla JS, styled with Pure CSS.

claims.quote: Uses very basic authentication using a provided password.
claims.statement: Authentication uses a provided password (described as very basic).

claims.quote: It's not encrypted in transport.
claims.statement: Boundary claim: the authentication is not encrypted in transport by the application itself.

claims.quote: **Tracking or spying of any kind.**
claims.statement: The target performs no tracking or spying of any kind — no analytics, telemetry or user surveillance.

claims.quote:
The only logs that still exist are
  some very simple ones, mostly meant for debugging.
claims.statement: The only logging the target performs is a small set of simple logs intended mainly for debugging.

claims.quote:
**User management.** If you need a shortener for your whole organization, either
  run separate containers for everyone or use something else.
claims.statement: The target has no user management or multi-user support; organizations must run separate instances.

claims.quote:
**Cookies, newsletters**, "we value your privacy" popups or any of the multiple
  other ways modern web shows how anti-user it is. We all hate those, and they're
  not needed here.
claims.statement: The target uses no cookies, newsletters, consent popups or similar anti-user mechanisms.

claims.quote: **Paywalls** or messages begging for donations.
claims.statement: The target contains no paywalls and no donation-request messages.

claims.quote:
The list of adjectives and names used for random short url generation is a modified
  version of [this list used by docker](https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/master/internal/namesgenerator/names-generator.go).
claims.statement: The word list used for random short URL generation is derived from (a modified version of) Docker's names-generator list.

claims.quote: Although it's unlikely, it's possible that your database is mangled after some update.
claims.statement: The target carries a possible, though unlikely, risk that the database is corrupted (mangled) by some software update.

claims.quote:
If you intend to have more than a few thousand short links, it's strongly recommended that you use the UID
  [`CHHOTO_SLUG_STYLE`](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_slug_style) with a [`CHHOTO_SLUG_LENGTH`](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_slug_length)
  of 16 or more. Otherwise, generating new links will start to fail after a while.
claims.statement: With the default slug generation settings, generating new links will start to fail once the target holds more than a few thousand short links; larger deployments require CHHOTO_SLUG_STYLE with a CHHOTO_SLUG_LENGTH of 16 or more.

claims.quote: For safety, only `https`,`http`,`ftp`, and `magnet` links are allowed for long links by default.
claims.statement: By default, the target accepts only https, http, ftp and magnet protocols for long links; other protocols require the CHHOTO_EXTRA_PROTOCOLS setting.
